_readme: LIVE NOTES — the one channel that fills from outside src/.
Everything else in this mind was authored by hand and locked: preview.html is
the senior document, V02_OVERLAY is the one declared place src/ may diverge
from it, and both are edited by a person in an editor. THIS file is written by
the site itself, through the editor at editor.html, and committed to the repo
by whoever GitHub says is allowed to push. That is the whole security model:
the lock is on the commit, not on the button.
Notes merge through the SAME addOnce guards as the overlay, so a note can
never overwrite an id the locked corpus already declares. The mind Siddhesh
wrote by hand stays senior; the notes accumulate around it.
SCHEMA — every field is checked by tools/notescheck.js, which refuses the
build rather than publishing something malformed. See CONTENT-MODEL.md for
what the vocabularies mean; they are that file's, not invented here.
notes[]   id        stable slug, unique across the whole graph
t         belief|thought|question|contradiction|project|
experiment|person|reference
label     the title, uppercase
mig       the single owning region, an id that really exists
crosses[] other region ids it reaches; never its own
state     seed|growing|formed|tested|proven|changed|open
register  what KIND of statement it is. Free text. A register
carrying a disclaimer after an em-dash is doing safety
work and must never be simplified away.
src       provenance. Live notes are first-hand, so this says so.
An absent src means 'not his writing' and would be a lie
here, which is why the checker requires it.
line      the material itself — what he actually wanted to say
added     ISO date the note was written, set by the editor
minors[]  same shape minus t/register/src/line — structural scaffolding
only, and scaffolding carries no src because it is not his words
edges[]   [fromId, toId, verb, gloss]
The verb is semantic, never 'related to'. Direction is
load-bearing: it is always rendered in the edge's own direction.
The gloss says why the edge exists and must be >= 25 characters.
No duplicate pair, no inverted duplicate, no self-loop.
The store starts empty on purpose. Nothing in here was written by anyone but
Siddhesh, and inventing a note to make the file look populated would be
exactly the Tier 3 fabrication the content rule forbids.

notes.label: HAPPINESS
notes.line:
Happiness is, to set a goal and move towards it. Regardless of the setbacks along the way. 
To set a goal and achieve it. 
To set a goal and be in constant momentum. 
Constant momentum that keeps moving towards it. 
To not quit, To Persist regardless of adversities, That's happiness.
And being one of those lucky ones who get to witness this sheer momentum of persistence, I wouldn't trade this life for any other even if given a chance.
